diagnosis.rationale: The undiluted trace shows normal exponential growth to about 6–7 h followed by a stationary-phase plateau around OD 1.31–1.37. Dilution checks did not reveal a large hidden OD: at 18 h, 5×, 10×, and 20× dilutions back-calculate to about 1.45, 1.42 (replicates 1.33–1.48), and 1.40, while at 12 h the 10× dilution back-calculates to 1.356 versus an undiluted 1.343. Thus the diluted measurements are internally consistent and close to the undiluted plateau rather than indicating strong reader saturation or continued biomass accumulation. The small ~0.05–0.10 OD elevation at 18 h is within replicate/dilution noise and not supported at 12 h, so the final-hours biomass is best regarded as at the level indicated by the undiluted readings.
